selection.size_measure: Total proposed homes in each application, across all its phases. Counts do not imply homes are completed or currently for sale.
selection.coverage: Five of the largest verified residential proposals in the non-closed application snapshot; reviewed descriptions and City reports, including Georgetown whose GIS description omits its unit total. Not a guaranteed exhaustive citywide ranking.
selection.excluded: 24-0286-00 Gateway is Concluded in current City GIS. Georgetown West uses 2,079 homes in the September 2025 report, replacing an older 2,208 count.
selection.geometry: Official application site outlines for all five additions. Bristol Estates, Regency Gardens and Georgetown West now have approximate source-plan massing, with per-component provenance. The two Guildford projects retain outlines only because suitable plans and complete building heights have not been verified.

projects.title: Guildford Town Centre redevelopment
projects.headline: Proposed: 4,652 homes · 11 towers
projects.summary: Proposal for 11 towers with 4,652 homes, 28,466 m² of commercial space and a future school and park site.

projects.title: Bristol Estates
projects.headline: Proposed: about 2,730 homes · 6 towers
projects.summary: Phased proposal for six residential towers, including three mixed-use buildings, with about 2,730 homes and 1,807 m² of commercial space, including a childcare centre. Towers range from 32 to 52 storeys.

projects.title: Regency Gardens redevelopment
projects.headline: Proposed: 2,705 homes · 12 buildings
projects.summary: Proposal for seven high-rise and five mid-rise buildings with 2,705 homes, including 321 rental homes, and 2,227 m² of commercial space. Buildings range from 6 to 48 storeys.

projects.title: Georgetown West
projects.headline: Proposed: 2,079 homes · 5 towers + low-rise
projects.summary: Phased proposal for five towers of 30, 33, 40, 44 and 47 storeys, plus a six-storey building, with 2,079 homes, shops, offices and public park space. This entry covers Georgetown West; neighbouring Georgetown phases are separate applications.

projects.title: Guildford — five-tower proposal
projects.headline: Proposed: 1,602 homes · 5 towers
projects.summary: Proposal for 1,602 homes in five towers, approximately 28 to 46 storeys, across five phases, plus a separate childcare building and 866 m² of commercial space. Phase 2 proposes a 46-storey tower with 426 homes; those homes are part of the overall total.
